name: dartx
description: Syntax highlighting, live diagnostics, tag closing and snippets for .dartx files (Dart with JSX-style markup, from the reactx package).

commands.title: dartx: Open the generated Dart file

dartx.dartPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `dart` executable used to run the dartx transpiler.

dartx.languageServer.enabled.markdownDescription:
Run the dartx language server, which gives `.dartx` files real type errors, hover, go-to-definition and find-references by proxying to the Dart analysis server.

**It starts a second analysis server**, alongside the one the Dart extension already runs — roughly 500 MB and a core of its own. On a large workspace that is felt. Turn this off to fall back to markup-only checking, which costs almost nothing.

dartx.transpilerArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to `dart` to invoke the transpiler. Change this if you vendored `bin/dartx.dart` somewhere else, e.g. `["run", "tool/dartx.dart"]`.

dartx.diagnostics.enabled.description: Report dartx compile errors in the editor.

dartx.diagnostics.runOn.description: Whether to re-check the file as you type or only when it is saved.

dartx.diagnostics.debounce.description: Milliseconds to wait after the last keystroke before re-checking.

dartx.autoCloseTags.description: Insert the matching closing tag when you finish an opening tag, and complete the name when you type `</`.

enumDescriptions: Collapse each generated .dartx.dart under the .dartx it came from.
Remove them from the explorer and quick-open entirely.
dartx.hideGeneratedFiles.markdownDescription: What to do with the `.dartx.dart` files the builder writes next to your sources. They are committed on purpose — that is what lets a package build without running `build_runner` first — but they are not files you edit.
